name: Luxembourg
notes: Seed pass: national supporters; 12 cantons and 100 communes registered, none swept. Map: ACT Limites administratives (communes, updated 2026-10-05), CC0, LAU2 commune codes; cantons are the regions (LAU1 codes with LU- prefix). Seats tab built by hand from the Chamber's member list at chd.lu (no seats.py adapter yet); Sam Tanson lit. The corporate net wealth tax is excluded (companies only).

polls.scope: Luxembourg residents, survey for a LISER study
polls.question: Agreement with a one-time tax on net worth to pay for COVID-19 costs (rates and exemption amounts varied at random between respondents)
polls.pollster: LISER (Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research), Olivera and Van Kerm
polls.support_text: 58 per cent agreed or strongly agreed; the survey tested a one-off tax, not a recurring one
